evidence.boundary: Direction instability and missing tradability-risk-flag/cost checks prevent promotion.

mechanism.math_forced_insight: Residualization can remove a broad volume-level component, but endpoint direction can flip if the residual risk proxy aliases liquidity, size, or regime exposure.
mechanism.payer: stocks with unstable price-volume residual risk should demand compensation or be avoided
mechanism.random_object: cross-sectional regression residual and its rolling time-series standard deviation
mechanism.receiver: portfolio that prefers stable residual price-volume relationship after removing cross-sectional volume level

relations.note: The factor starts from cross-sectional regression residuals.
Regression projects close on volume before measuring residual volatility.
IS and OOS endpoint direction differed, so it is not yet a clean long-only factor.
Future formal evidence must join tradability flags and transaction cost.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node for residualization or low-vol/liquidity diagnostic ideas.
Before promotion, compare against simple volatility and liquidity-volatility baselines.
Treat sign and endpoint direction as unstable until tradability filters and cost model are applied.
summary: CS residual volatility regresses close on volume cross-sectionally, then rewards lower rolling residual volatility; it has IC evidence but unstable endpoint direction and should be treated as a risk/liquidity diagnostic.
title: Cross-sectional close-volume residual volatility diagnostic
